maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is management fees from managed REITs and private capital vehicles, not repair, servicing or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Fees come from REITs, private investors and tenants-paid real estate vehicles, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by managing REITs and raising private capital funds and separate accounts, not by buying companies in a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Long-term external management contracts with affiliated REITs run their properties; switching manager is costly and disruptive.

notes: Mission-critical rests on long-term external management agreements with affiliated REITs; ease of switching is somewhat uncertain.
